profiles.name: correctness
profiles.purpose: Prove mechanics and policy-boundary invariants without gameplay.

profiles.name: fixed-work-strength
profiles.purpose: Compare policy quality at an exact algorithmic configuration.

profiles.name: machine-max-throughput
profiles.purpose: Find the fastest stable end-to-end configuration inside explicit CPU, shared-memory, GPU, and thermal limits.

profiles.name: resource-frontier
profiles.purpose: Report quality and throughput across latency, CPU, host/shared memory, GPU memory, and energy budgets.

rules: A fixed-time configuration is a distinct algorithmic candidate when hardware changes completed work or actions.
CPU and integrated-GPU memory are overlapping capacity and are never summed.
Thread, batch, cache, and memory choices are frozen before controlled policy-quality data is read.
Unavailable resource measurements are explicit nulls with a reason.
